newsitem.title: USA: Capstar completes $100 mln deal to buy Osborn.
newsitem.headline: Capstar completes $100 mln deal to buy Osborn.

text.p: Capstar Broadcasting Partners, an Austin, Texas,-based radio group, said Friday it has completed its previously announced acquisition deal valued at over $100 million, of Osborn Communications Corp.

Greenwich, Conn.,-based Osborn owns and operates diverse media properties including, after certain announced acquisitions and dispositions, 20 FM and AM radio stations in mid-sized markets in the eastern United States.
Capstar Broadcasting was formed in May last year by the private investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc, of Dallas, and radio industry veteran R. Steven Hicks.
